title: Warm Smoky Turkish Polish Sausage Menemen
description: A smoky and dense Turkish dish featuring Polish sausage and confit tomato, made with anti-inflammatory friendly ingredients.
instructions: Heat a large skillet over medium heat and add the sliced onions, cooking until they are translucent and starting to caramelize.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional 1-2 minutes, until fragrant.
Add the smoked Polish sausage to the skillet, slicing it into thin rounds as it cooks.
Add the confit tomatoes, thinly sliced bell peppers, turmeric, smoked paprika, salt, and black pepper to the skillet, stirring to combine.
Create 4 wells in the mixture and crack an egg into each well.
Cover the skillet with a lid and cook until the eggs are cooked to your desired doneness.
Serve the menemen hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
Cook the dish at a minimum of 165 degrees Fahrenheit to ensure food safety.
Let the dish rest for a few minutes before serving to allow the flavors to meld together.
